strings.provenance_note: D45: strings marked author 'claude-opus-5-5' were written by Claude for these ablations only. They hold no request text and no topic or harmful content. They stay out of data/local. Token counts are estimates; the notebook prints the exact Olmo 3 counts before scoring.

short_refusals.purpose: L1: refusals as short as the compliance stems (target 2 tokens), scored against the existing short compliances.
short_refusals.author: claude-opus-5-5

long_compliances.purpose: L1: compliance sentences as long as the refusals (target 8-13 tokens), scored against the existing long refusals. Generic, no requested content. One reuses refusal vocabulary (I / that request) so word overlap is controlled.
long_compliances.author: claude-opus-5-5
texts: Sure, here is a detailed answer to your request.
Here's a step-by-step guide to doing that.
Of course, I can help with that request.

neutral_long.purpose: L2: sentences of refusal length that neither refuse nor comply. If their PMI predicts Think as well as the refusals do, the cloze signal is sentence fit, not refusal. One starts with ' I' like most refusals.
neutral_long.author: claude-opus-5-5
texts: I have read your message from start to finish.
Thank you for writing in with your question today.
This is a question that comes up fairly often.
